sentences.text: Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that incident is said to have occurred in year 2010.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that statement of applicant was recorded in year 2016, 2017 and 2019 and now investigation is complete and charge sheet is to be filed.
Notice was only issued to applicant to seek his presence before the Court and not to arrest him.
In these circumstances, application for grant of anticipatory bail may be dismissed.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5. Offence under Section 467 of the IPC is non-bailable and punishable with life imprisonment.
In these circumstances, there are chances that applicant may be arrested on appearing before Court.
During course of investigation, applicant has cooperated in investigation of case and his statement has also been recorded.
Incident is of year 2010 and charge sheet is being filed in year 2023.
6. Considering aforesaid circumstances, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rs.
One Lac Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.
7. The applicant is directed to join the investigation immediately and to co-operate with the investigating agency.

He will further abide by the condition enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
8.
